player.desc: Plays every video and audio format.
player.lead: A modern video and audio player that opens anything — MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, FLAC, WAV and more — in a blink.
points: Three looks to choose from: Glass, Edit Bay and alva.
A home page with your recent videos, downloads and files as a moving showreel. Turn each row on or off.
Autoplay on or off: files open playing, or paused until you press play.
Window motion: instant, smooth or cinematic.
Stays ready in the background, so files open almost instantly.
File details for any file — streams, colour, HDR, chapters — one click to copy.
Keyboard shortcuts for everything.
player.note: Can become your video & audio player in Windows.
player.note_mac: Opens any video or audio file from Finder: right-click › Open With › the player.

foldernator.desc: A file explorer with status colours and themes.
foldernator.lead: A file explorer for Windows that does what Explorer does — and looks the way you want.
points: Status colours on folders, so you see where every project stands at a glance.
Themes, including a real see-through Liquid Glass — or build your own.
Choose your folder and icon styles.
Fluidity: no motion, smooth or liquid.
Media details for any video or audio file (Ctrl+I).
Your Quick access pins, Home and This PC, just like Windows.
foldernator.note: Folder colours show in Windows' own Explorer too.
foldernator.lead_mac: A Finder alternative for your Mac: it does what Finder does — and looks the way you want.
points_mac: Status colours on folders, so you see where every project stands at a glance — they show in Finder too, as tags.
Themes with the Mac's own see-through glass — or build your own.
Choose your folder and icon styles.
Fluidity: no motion, smooth or liquid.
Media details for any video or audio file (⌘I on a video).
Your Desktop, Documents, Downloads, iCloud Drive and disks in the sidebar.
foldernator.note_mac: Works alongside Finder: same files, same Trash, same tags.

prompterinator.desc: A teleprompter that follows your voice.
prompterinator.lead: A teleprompter that scrolls as you speak. It listens on your PC — nothing goes online.
points: Voice follow keeps your place while you talk. Or set a speed and go.
Mirror the text for a glass prompter, or send it to a second screen.
Fonts, sizes, colours, margins and the reading band — all adjustable.
Give every speaker their own colour.
Countdown, on-screen clock and cues for whoever is reading.
Opens Word, PDF and Excel scripts.
Save your setups as templates.
prompterinator.note: Voice downloads its speech model (about 460 MB) the first time you turn it on.

nomorewriting.lead: Press a key, speak, and your words are typed for you — in any app. It all runs on your PC; nothing is sent anywhere.
points: Pick your own shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+W to start).
It tidies what you said: punctuation, line breaks and lists.
Speed or accuracy — five levels, from instant to most precise.
Teach it your words: names, brands and your own expressions.
Style the recording overlay: theme, colour, size and where it sits.
Choose your microphone; auto level means you never have to shout.
Works in several languages.
nomorewriting.note: Downloads its AI models while it installs (about 5 GB). Fastest with an NVIDIA graphics card.
nomorewriting.note_mac: Downloads its AI models while it installs (about 5 GB). Runs on your Mac's own chip; asks once for Microphone and Accessibility.

bloom.desc: Your notifications, redesigned, with your sound.
bloom.lead: Every notification on your PC arrives in bloom's own style: the icon appears first, the message slides out, and your sound plays.
points: 8 designs to choose from, from a glowing pill to an arrow-tipped ribbon.
Colours: each app's own brand colours, 5 presets, or any colour you pick.
App icons your way: shape, background and logo size.
Your own sound: drop any audio file on the window; volume up to 150%.
Where it appears and how long it stays (or the same as Windows).
Long messages: grow to fit, or only the essentials.
One switch hides Windows' own popup for every app, and turning it off puts it all back.
bloom.note: Windows only. Runs quietly next to the clock.

framehud.desc: Your FPS and PC stats over any game.
framehud.lead: A small overlay that shows how your game is really running: frames per second, frame time and your PC's vitals, right on top of the game.
points: FPS, frame time and 1% lows for DirectX, OpenGL and Vulkan games.
GPU use, temperature, VRAM, power and clock; CPU and RAM.
Ping to the game's own server, found automatically.
Pick which stats show, their labels and their order.
Your font, colours, opacity and outline; one row or a list.
Any corner of any monitor, or drag it where you want.
Hotkeys: Ctrl+Shift+F10 show/hide, F11 move, F12 settings.
framehud.note: Windows only. Counting frames needs admin: tick Start with Windows and it never asks again. GPU stats need an NVIDIA graphics card.

depthmotion.desc: Real footage in, pure motion out.
depthmotion.lead: Turns any clip into motion references for AI video: the bodies, timing and camera of a real scene, without its faces, clothes or set — so Seedance, Kling or a depth ControlNet moves like the real thing.
points: Clay pass: a grey clay render, made for Seedance 2.5's blockout (white model) reference.
People in colour: it follows each person, even ones who walk in later, and you pick their colours.
New location: the same motion in a new Blender set (ruins, studio or street), through the clip's own camera.
Depth for Kling, Wan VACE and ControlNets, plus normal maps and 16-bit frames for Blender or Resolve.
Trim to the action, and isolate the subjects so only their motion is copied.
A library of your scenes, with Foldernator's status colours.
Light on your PC: it runs beside your open apps and pauses if your PC needs memory. Nothing is uploaded.
depthmotion.note: Windows only. Needs an NVIDIA graphics card; downloads its AI engine once (about 3 GB). New location needs Blender (free). Best quality is for non-commercial use; Fast is free for any use.

sentinel.desc: A free antivirus that catches and quarantines real malware.
sentinel.lead: A lightweight antivirus that scans files and folders, watches for threats as they land, and moves anything dangerous into quarantine — on by default, nothing uploaded unless you ask.
points: Scan any file or folder, or drop something in and let it check on the spot.
Real-time guard: watches a folder and catches threats the moment they appear.
Catches and quarantines on its own — the threat is moved out of reach, not just flagged.
Safe Install: run an installer under close watch, so anything it tries is caught live.
Optional online check: paste your own free VirusTotal key to compare against 70+ engines.
Optional deep rules: fetches a large community threat-rule pack on demand.
Light on your PC: a plain Python engine, no account, no telemetry, nothing sent out.
sentinel.note: Windows only. The online check is optional and needs your own free VirusTotal key. It never replaces Windows Security — run it alongside.
